parts.title: Listening Passage 1
parts.transcriptHtml:
WOMAN：Welcome to Houston Community College, how can I help you?

MAN：I’m thinking of signing up for a course. I have some free time these days and would like to try something different.

What courses are available?

WOMAN：We have a few available at the moment. Is there any particular day that suits you best?

MAN：Any day is good except for Thursday.

WOMAN：Ok, we have lots of courses on the other days. For example, we have our Skating class on Tuesday.

MAN：That sounds interesting. I’ve never skated before. Are there any courses for novices?

WOMAN：Sure, actually this course mainly includes basic skills and our professional coaches will teach you.

MAN：That’s great. When does it begin?

WOMAN：It used to begin at 8pm, but since it’s very popular, now it starts at 7. 45 pm and goes until quite late in the evening. It is a lot of fun.

MAN：Those times work perfectly for me. How much does it cost then?

WOMAN：It’s 650 dollars.

MAN：Oh. I see. . . That’s going to be quite expensive for me. I mean, I’m going to have to buy the equipment too.

WOMAN：You don’t need to buy any equipment. The skates are included in the price.

MAN：Oh. Ok, maybe that’s not so bad then.

WOMAN：But you will need to wear warm clothes since it can be very cold late at night.

It would be good to have something to keep you warm.
